autonomyLevels.name: Manual
autonomyLevels.meaning: People perform and approve the work.

autonomyLevels.name: Prepared
autonomyLevels.meaning: Software researches and drafts; people release outputs.

autonomyLevels.name: Supervised
autonomyLevels.meaning: A person approves each external change.

autonomyLevels.name: Bounded
autonomyLevels.meaning: Preauthorized routine work runs within explicit limits; exceptions go to an owner.

autonomyLevels.name: Managed
autonomyLevels.meaning: Bounded workflows coordinate across systems with monitored recovery and an accountable service owner.

services.name: Agency knowledge and delivery desk
services.cap: One client; up to five active roles and twenty delivery milestones. Recruiting interviews excluded.
outcomes: Source register with access owners and review dates
Weekly decisions brief with proposed meeting changes
services.qualityReview: Check twenty source-to-output links and every invoice total against accepted milestones.
humanExtras: Named owner reviews the weekly brief and invoice drafts.
Adds two 45-minute client decision sessions and source cleanup.
Adds one 90-minute operating-design session and a 30-day adoption review.

services.name: Structured talent delivery
services.cap: One open role; up to 25 completed screens. No guaranteed hire.
outcomes: Accepted role criteria and sourcing brief
Reviewed outreach and source-linked interview evidence
Human hiring decision handoff and agreed next steps
services.qualityReview: Blind-review twenty evidence statements against transcripts; sample candidate experience separately.
humanExtras: Recruiter reviews screens; employer conducts selection interviews.
Adds up to six 45-minute structured human interviews and calibration.
Adds a 90-minute team agreement session, two check-ins and a 30-day integration review.

services.name: Onboarding and manager enablement
services.cap: Up to three new hires and their managers; one role family.
outcomes: Role-specific 30-day plan with accepted learning artifacts
Manager and new-hire review with unresolved blockers
services.qualityReview: Verify every task has an owner, due date and acceptance test; measure accepted artifacts due by day 30.
humanExtras: Owner reviews plans and weekly blockers.
Adds a 45-minute kickoff and two 30-minute manager sessions.
Adds up to three 45-minute individual role-transition sessions and a cohort integration review.

services.name: Team working agreements
services.cap: One team of up to eight people. Workplace facilitation; no clinical service.
outcomes: One implemented meeting experiment with a baseline
30-day review of agreements used and work completed
services.qualityReview: Every agreement needs an owner and review date; private reflection never becomes an employee score.
humanExtras: Facilitator prepares and reviews one 60-minute agreement session.
Adds a 90-minute facilitated session and two team check-ins.
Adds two 60-minute leadership sessions, structured dissent preparation and a 30-day review.

services.name: Retreat planning and outcome delivery
services.cap: One team, 8–20 participants, up to two program days. Travel, venue, food and accommodation excluded.
outcomes: Outcome brief, comparable supplier assumptions and readiness packet
Timed runbook with named decision owners and participation alternatives
Reconciled service costs and accepted day-7/day-30 action handoff
services.qualityReview: Compare every commitment to scope and receipt; track accepted actions due by day 30, not attendance alone.
humanExtras: Remote planning support; client supplies onsite host and facilitator.
Adds one facilitated program day; named onsite host remains separately scoped.
Adds two facilitated program days and two integration sessions; qualified onsite support still separately budgeted.

services.name: People operations improvement
services.cap: One company, up to 30 employees and two defined process improvements. Payroll, legal advice and employee investigations excluded.
outcomes: Accepted process baseline and source register
Two implemented process artifacts with accountable owners
Service review covering effort, exceptions and accepted improvements
services.qualityReview: Verify process outputs against their signed acceptance checks; retain an explicit human escalation route.
humanExtras: Adds two 60-minute manager workshops and process coaching.
Adds four 60-minute leadership working sessions and facilitated implementation follow-through.
